title: Learning: Per-User Upstream Credentials
text: Each engineer has connected their own GitHub account to the company's MCP gateway. A user asks to list their open pull requests through the GitHub MCP server, which knows nothing about your IdP.
teaches: When the upstream server doesn't trust your IdP, no exchange can help: the gateway needs a credential the upstream already accepts.
Store one credential per user and pick the one for the user who is asking.
A shared admin credential erases who did what and gives everyone admin's reach.
covers: MCP Per-User and Per-Key Upstream Credentials
